reviews.t: Amazing product, salon quality and pays for itself the first use

reviews.t: Love love love, but battery doesn’t last super long
reviews.x: I love the cordless feature. I now can curl my hair while getting other chores done. You can customize the curls depending on the temperature, the amount of time you hold the curl, and the size of hair you use. My only complaint is that the battery life does not last long. I have shoulder length hair and can do my whole head, but my friend with slightly longer hair can’t finish her head before the battery runs out.

reviews.t: No curl added to my straight hair – just a slight wave
reviews.x: I was excited to use this product. When I received it I am mediately heated it up and tried to curl my hair. I used a very small sections and was extremely disappointed. Even very small sections of hair barely made a dent of a wave. I was expecting curls and this definitely did not deliver. I’m definitely returning it.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the curler easy to use and effective at creating curls, including for children.
Several reviewers report hair getting stuck, tangled, or burned during use.
Battery life and reliability are common complaints, with some units dying quickly or arriving broken.
Some reviewers praise the curls as beautiful and salon-quality, especially for the price.
A few reviewers mention packaging damage or missing instructions.
